mechanism: Both drugs increase risk of osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ) and impair bone metabolism; prednisolone enhances immunosuppression and increases infection risk while zoledronic acid causes bisphosphonate-related complications.
action: Monitor closely for ONJ signs, ensure adequate dental hygiene and preventive dental care before initiating therapy, consider alternative therapies if prolonged high-dose prednisolone required, and assess renal function regularly as both drugs affect kidney clearance.
